text_block.text: 生成された動画：Generated video: Create a realistic high-end cinematic scene using the provided visual references. Maintain strong visual and character continuity throughout the entire scene. Begin with a smooth cinematic establishing shot of the training ground. Several disciples are training naturally in the background. Some practice sword techniques in pairs while others watch the sparring match in the center. Yasuo is sparring with another disciple while Yone calmly watches from the side. Yasuo fights fast, aggressively and with complete confidence. The opponent attacks. Yasuo quickly avoids the strike and counters, taking control of the fight. Their exchange becomes faster and more intense. Yasuo finishes the sparring exchange with one powerful but controlled sword strike, knocking the opponent off balance and sending him falling outside the training area. The opponent is defeated but not seriously injured. The surrounding disciples react naturally. Some are surprised and impressed by Yasuo’s speed and skill, while others exchange uneasy looks because he clearly used more force than necessary. Yasuo looks toward the defeated opponent and gives a small, confident smile. Shift focus naturally toward Yone. Yone remains calm and unimpressed. He walks toward Yasuo while the other disciples remain naturally active in the background. Yone looks directly at Yasuo. Yone’s voice is a deep, smooth adult male baritone, calm, disciplined and controlled. He speaks slowly and deliberately with quiet authority. His delivery is natural and restrained, never theatrical. Yone says: “You used too much force again.” Yasuo turns toward Yone. Yasuo’s voice is a young adult male baritone, low and slightly rough, with a subtle natural rasp. His delivery is confident and energetic but still natural and restrained. Yasuo replies: “But I won.” Yone answers in the exact same deep, smooth, calm and controlled voice: “Master didn’t tell you to win.” Yasuo’s confident smile slowly disappears. He looks directly at Yone, confused and slightly challenged by what he just heard, as if he is about to respond. End on Yasuo looking at Yone. Keep the sword sparring fast, skilled and physically believable, with natural body weight, footwork, momentum and weapon impacts. Keep the background disciples secondary to Yasuo and Yone. Their movements and reactions should feel natural and unscripted. Dialogue must be spoken naturally by the correct character with accurate lip synchronization. Keep each character’s voice clearly distinct and consistent throughout the scene. No magical abilities, no wind powers, no glowing effects, no teleportation, no anime-style movement and no game-like visual effects. Natural cinematic camera movement, realistic physical motion and high-end live-action feature-film quality. Aspect ratio: 16:9 cinematic widescreen.、16:9, 16:9、16:9
